room.spatial_character: A television-free living room organized for conversation, relaxed sitting, and occasional serving rather than a media-viewing axis.
daily_activities: relaxed sitting with a movable footrest
placing drinks or serving items away from the entry
room.organization: The north-wall sofa is the primary seat. One diagonal armchair closes the group from the east, an offset coffee table serves both, and a movable ottoman supports the sofa's west end. A south-east console provides a separate landing surface while the south-west entry and center-south strip remain open.
room.main_path: Enter through the south-west door, move east along the open south strip, then branch north-west to the sofa, north-east to the armchair and lamp, or east to the console without crossing the coffee table group.
room.protected_open_space: The full south-west door turn-in, the center-south circulation field, the sofa's west approach, and the east window clearance remain free of fixed furniture.

openings.placement_rationale: The south-west entry opens into an empty south band; console_serving_south_east is far to the east, while all seating begins north of the inward door clearance.

The east-north window gives side daylight to the conversation group; floor_lamp_armchair and armchair_conversation_east remain west of its clearance, so the glazing strip stays usable and visually open.

furniture.placement_rationale: The sofa is the dominant conversation seat and is backed by the north wall, facing south into the room rather than toward a television. Its central approach remains open from the entry, while its west seat is paired with the movable ottoman without blocking the armchair route.

The compact armchair closes the seating group from the east and turns north-west toward both sofa_conversation_north and coffee_table_shared. It remains well west of the east window clearance and admits a south-west approach from the main circulation field.

The coffee table is offset north of the geometric room center, within reach of the sofa and diagonal armchair but outside the south circulation band. Its narrow depth leaves a practical gap to the sofa and a clear service approach from the south.

The small ottoman sits in front of the sofa's west seat as a footrest or movable extra perch. It is separated laterally from coffee_table_shared, remains inside the sofa use area, and releases the diagonal armchair's south-west approach.

The slim floor lamp uses the small pocket east of armchair_conversation_east, close enough to support evening sitting without entering the chair's south-west approach. Its footprint remains west of the window clearance and north of the route to the console.

The narrow console sits on the south-east wall as a drinks and serving surface, leaving the south-west entry entirely open. It faces north into its own working strip and stays far enough south of armchair_conversation_east to preserve the main branch path.
